# BlindMonk.in

> BlindMonk builds software, AI integrations, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity solutions for organizations and product teams.

Use the public pages below as the source of truth. The same content is available to people and automated search/retrieval systems; this file does not describe hidden or crawler-exclusive content.

- [Software engineering](https://blindmonk.in/software): Software division, services, and products.
- [Services](https://blindmonk.in/software/services): Custom development, AI, cloud, security, and training services.
- [Products](https://blindmonk.in/software/products): BlindMonk's product portfolio.
- [Marketing](https://blindmonk.in/marketing): Performance marketing and advertising.

## Engineering services

- [AI development and workflow automation](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/custom-ai-integrations): Integrate AI capabilities into products and automate workflows.
- [AI as a service](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/ai-as-a-service): Build and operate AI-powered services.
- [Web development](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/web-app-development): Design and engineering for web applications.
- [Full-stack SaaS development](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/fullstack-saas-development): Build and scale SaaS products.
- [API and backend engineering](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/api-backend-engineering): Backend systems and API development.
- [Security automation, audits, and penetration testing](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/security-audits-pentesting): Security workflow planning and authorized security assessments.
- [Cybersecurity training](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/cybersecurity-training): Security training for teams.
- [Ethical hacking workshops](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/ethical-hacking-workshops): Authorized, educational security workshops.
- [Cloud hosting and deployment](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/cloud-hosting-deployment): Cloud infrastructure and deployment support.
- [CI/CD setup](https://blindmonk.in/software/services/cicd-setup): Automated build and deployment pipelines.
